overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、劳动经济学（2 篇）、公司金融（1 篇）。方法上以优化方法、模型校准为主。来源分布：arXiv（12 篇）。

papers.title: Partial identification with entropy regularized optimal transport
papers.abstract: In many statistical settings, the available data and maintained assumptions do not suffice to uniquely identify the model parameters of interest. In such cases, one can only identify sets which are guaranteed to contain the true parameters. These are often characterized through linear programs that optimize over models compatible with the observed data. These programs can be infinite-dimensional in the optimizer and the number of constraints. We provide a unified way to characterize and solve such optimization problems by phrasing them as optimal transport problems on path spaces. This allows us to regularize the problem with an entropy penalty, recasting it as a multi-marginal entropic optimal transport problem, which can be solved efficiently via Sinkhorn iterations. In addition, it allows us to establish convergence of the regularized value to the sharpest bound, derive consistency rates for a plug-in estimator, and obtain asymptotic distribution for approximate bounds. The method is general and accommodates settings ranging from instrumental variable models with continuous variables to welfare estimation in heterogeneous demand models. We verify the statistical and computational properties in simulations and provide an application to demand estimation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在许多统计场景中，现有的数据及所采用的假设不足以唯一确定我们感兴趣的模型参数。在这种情况下，我们只能识别出那些必然包含真实参数的参数集合。这些集合通常通过线性规划来描述，该规划用于优化与观测数据兼容的模型。这些线性规划在优化器和约束条件的数量上可能具有无限维的特性。我们提出了一种统一的方法来描述和解决这类优化问题，即将它们转化为路径空间上的最优传输问题。这种方法允许我们通过引入熵惩罚来对问题进行正则化处理，将其重新表述为多边际熵最优传输问题，并通过Sinkhorn迭代算法高效求解。此外，该方法还能确保正则化后的解收敛到最精确的界限，推导出插值估计量的一致性速率，并获得近似界限的渐近分布。该方法具有通用性，适用于从包含连续变量的工具变量模型到异质需求模型中的福利估计等多种场景。我们通过模拟验证了该方法的统计和计算特性，并提供了一个实际应用案例——需求估计。。研究方法：工具变量、数值模拟、优化方法。

papers.title: Food Insecurity Among Military Veterans
papers.abstract: Veterans face multiple hardships after they leave the military. Is food insecurity one of these hardships? This paper examines the long-term effects of military service on food insecurity using new data from the PSID. Military veteran-headed households experienced lower food insecurity than non-veteran-headed households, and participated less in federal nutrition assistance programs. We use the Vietnam-era lottery draft to identify causal effects, and find no evidence that military service adversely affects food insecurity. Our results suggest policies that assist currently enlisted service members, and veterans unlikely to head a traditional household, may most effectively tackle food insecurity among military veterans.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】退伍军人在退役后面临诸多困境，其中是否包括食物安全问题？本文利用PSID（Panel Survey of Income Dynamics）的新数据，研究了军旅经历对食物安全状况的长期影响。结果显示，以退伍军人为户主的家庭相比非退伍军人为户主的家庭，食物安全问题更为突出，且参与联邦营养援助计划的比例也较低。我们通过越南战争时期的征兵制度来分析其中的因果关系，未发现军旅经历会对食物安全产生负面影响。研究结果表明，针对现役军人以及那些不太可能成为传统家庭户主的退伍军人的援助政策，可能是解决退伍军人食物安全问题的最有效途径。。

papers.title: Spouse-Protected Tontines: Household Decumulation via Neural-Network Optimization
papers.abstract: We develop a spouse-protected tontine in which a first death changes the household state but generates no pool transfer. The same account remains attached to the household contract until extinction and funds a spouse-only continuation phase if the retiree dies first. We derive contract-level actuarial-fairness conditions and a finite-pool mortality-credit allocation rule with exact ex post budget balance. Under a homogeneous large-pool approximation, we formulate a multidimensional decumulation problem for a representative household, with withdrawal and rebalancing controls while the retiree is alive. The objective balances expected cumulative real household payments against the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) of terminal shortfalls relative to household reserve targets, without conditioning on survival to the horizon. We develop a numerical solution method for this problem based on a global-in-time neural-network parameterization of admissible control policies. We quantify policy-induced spouse-continuation costs using expected-cost and risk-loaded payment-scale loads at both representative-contract and book levels. We characterize the large-book limit of average per-contract continuation cost as the expected representative-contract cost conditional on common market information.   Numerical experiments calibrated to Australia show that the spouse-only phase is a first-order and persistent household event. In these experiments, book-level diversification removes most of the representative-contract excess upper-tail cost of spouse continuation in the large-book limit, without changing expected per-contract continuation cost. A cross-country mortality comparison indicates that the prevalence and persistence of the spouse-only phase are not specific to Australia.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】我们设计了一种配偶保护型共同基金（tontine）制度：当其中一方先去世时，家庭状况会发生变化，但不会发生资金池的转移。该账户会一直与家庭合同保持关联，直至合同终止；如果退休者先去世，剩余资金将用于为配偶提供专属的后续保障。我们推导出了合同层面的精算公平性条件以及一个能够确保事后预算平衡的有限资金池死亡率与信用分配规则。在假设资金池规模较大的前提下，我们为代表性家庭构建了一个多维的累积支出模型，并考虑了退休者生前可进行的取款和再平衡操作。该模型的目标是在不考虑未来生存概率的情况下，平衡家庭预期的累计实际支出与因家庭储备目标不足而产生的条件风险价值（Conditional Value-at-Risk, CVaR）。为此，我们开发了一种基于全局时间神经网络参数化的数值求解方法来处理这类控制策略问题。我们通过预期成本和风险调整后的支付规模来量化政策对配偶后续保障成本的影响，这些指标涵盖了代表性合同层面和整体资金池层面。我们还分析了在共同市场信息已知的情况下，平均每份合同后续保障成本的极限表现。针对澳大利亚市场的数值实验表明，配偶专属保障阶段属于一种具有显著影响且持续存在的家庭事件；实验...。研究方法：模型校准、实验方法。

papers.title: The Limits of Rank-Dependent Priorities in School Choice
papers.abstract: Many school choice mechanisms give students higher priority at schools they rank highly and aim to reward students' eagerness. This paper studies whether a centralized mechanism can incorporate such rank-dependent priorities while preserving truthful reporting. I consider a mechanism that jointly specifies how reported preferences modify schools' original priorities and how assignments are determined based on the modified priorities. I require the modification rule to satisfy rank monotonicity and the resulting matching to be stable with respect to the modified priorities. These two requirements jointly capture the policy objective of rewarding eagerness. My main result shows that any mechanism satisfying these requirements as well as strategy-proofness is outcome equivalent to the student-proposing Deferred Acceptance mechanism using the original priorities. Thus, if eagerness affects the outcome while the rank-dependent policy goal is maintained, the mechanism must be manipulable.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】许多学校选择机制会给予学生在他们排名较高的学校中更高的优先权，并旨在奖励学生的积极性（即他们对学校的偏好）。本文探讨了一种中央集权式机制是否能够在保持学生真实报告意愿的前提下，同时体现这种基于排名的优先级安排。我研究了一种机制，该机制明确规定了学生报告的偏好如何调整学校的原始优先级，以及如何根据调整后的优先级来分配学生。我要求这种调整规则满足“排名单调性”（即偏好较高的学生优先被录取），并且由此产生的匹配结果在新的优先级下仍然稳定。这两个要求共同体现了奖励学生积极性的政策目标。我的主要研究结果表明：任何同时满足这些要求以及“策略防御性”（即防止学生通过策略操纵机制结果）的机制，在效果上等同于学生提出“延迟接受”（Deferred Acceptance）机制（该机制使用学校的原始优先级进行分配）。因此，如果学生的积极性确实会影响最终结果，而同时又维持了基于排名的优先级政策目标，那么这种机制就必然存在被操纵的可能性。。

papers.title: QuantCode Model: Specializing Language Models for Executable Algorithmic Trading Code
papers.abstract: Large language models are strong general-purpose code generators, but executable algorithmic trading remains a demanding specialization target: a model must translate a natural-language strategy specification into correct program logic for a specialized trading framework, execute on historical data, produce trades, and remain semantically faithful to the request. We study two complementary mechanisms for specializing language models for this setting: continued pretraining on algorithmic-trading framework code and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on agent-validated request-to-code pairs. Evaluation is centered on QuantCode-Bench, our 400-task benchmark for Backtrader strategy generation, together with a repository-level SWE-bench-like track. Continued pretraining improves single-turn Judge Pass from 41.5% to 47.5% for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B and from 27.8% to 33.0% for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. SFT applied after continued pretraining yields a larger gain for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, reaching 58.2% Judge Pass and 83.5% successful backtests; in agentic evaluation it raises first-turn success from 22.3% to 58.3% and final success after up to 10 turns from 47.5% to 79.5%. Continued pretraining alone improves first-turn agentic success but lowers final success after repair from 47.5% to 32.5%, consistent with degraded instruction following, whereas SFT improves both. We also identify a capability-retention failure: domain specialization degrades parser-conformant structured tool calling, and targeted recovery SFT restores tool-call formatting but not the base checkpoint's repository-level agent performance. The results show that framework-oriented pretraining, validated SFT, and explicit capability-retention evaluation address distinct failure modes in domain-specific executable code generation.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大型语言模型是强大的通用代码生成工具，但可执行的算法交易仍是一个具有挑战性的专业应用领域：模型需要将自然语言策略描述转化为适用于特定交易框架的正确程序逻辑，能够在历史数据上运行，生成交易指令，并在语义上忠实于原始请求。我们研究了两种用于针对这一场景对语言模型进行专业化的方法：一是持续对算法交易框架代码进行预训练；二是基于代理验证的“请求到代码”对数据进行监督式微调（SFT）。评估主要基于我们开发的QuantCode-Bench基准测试平台，该平台包含400个用于Backtrader策略生成的测试任务，同时还设有类似SWE-bench的仓库级评估模块。持续预训练将Qwen3.5-397B-A17B模型的单轮策略通过率从41.5%提升至47.5%，将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型的单轮通过率从27.8%提升至33.0%。在持续预训练之后应用SFT后，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型的单轮通过率进一步提升至58.2%，回测成功率达到83.5%；在代理评估中，其第一轮通过率从22.3%提升至58.3%，经过最多10轮修正后的最终成功率从47.5%提升至79.5%。仅进行持续预训练虽...。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Exchange Rate Determination for Cryptocurrency Mergers: A Formal Framework
papers.abstract: Many of the thousands of existing cryptocurrencies suffer from declining adoption, low liquidity and weak security, and merging two of them into a single ecosystem is a natural alternative to abandonment. No rigorous framework exists, however, for determining a fair exchange rate in such a merger. Unlike that of a corporation, the value of a cryptocurrency is driven by network effects, so the exchange rate itself influences the value of the merged asset. We extend the exchange-ratio framework of Mainini, Moretto and Visetti [7] by making the merged value endogenous: the exchange rate determines community migration, migration determines (up to user overlap) the post-merger network state, and an axiomatised valuation function assigns a value to that state. The resulting synergy has no predetermined sign, and the bounds of the bargaining region become self-referential in the exchange rate. We prove that no exchange rate at which the merger destroys value preserves wealth, and that the pre-merger price ratio preserves wealth exactly when the merger does not destroy value at that rate. In that case, under explicit threshold conditions, the price ratio satisfies all five of our fairness conditions -- wealth, adoption, security, governance and liquidity preservation -- and, under strict versions of these conditions, the admissible set contains a nondegenerate interval around it, the wealth-admissible set one of explicit width. The network-value laws proposed in the literature, from the linear law to Metcalfe's and its generalised power-law forms, share a convexity property that yields the Lipschitz control behind these estimates. Liquidity emerges as the only non-wealth condition that can disconnect the admissible set.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】现有的数千种加密货币中，许多都面临着采用率下降、流动性低以及安全性薄弱的问题。将其中两种加密货币合并成一个统一的生态系统，是避免它们被彻底淘汰的一种自然选择。然而，目前尚不存在一个严谨的框架来确定此类合并过程中的公平汇率。与公司的价值不同，加密货币的价值是由网络效应驱动的，因此汇率本身也会影响合并后资产的价值。我们扩展了Mainini、Moretto和Visetti[7]提出的汇率模型，将合并后的资产价值视为内生变量：汇率决定了用户群体的迁移情况，迁移情况又进一步影响了合并后的网络结构（在用户重叠范围内），而一个经过公理化处理的估值函数则为该网络结构赋予了相应的价值。这种合并所产生的协同效应具有不确定性（其符号无法预先确定），且谈判范围的边界与汇率本身密切相关。我们证明了：在任何会导致资产价值减少的汇率下，合并行为都无法实现财富的保值；只有在合并不会导致资产价值减少的情况下，合并前的价格比率才能确保财富的保值。在这种情况下，当满足特定的阈值条件时，该价格比率能够同时满足我们提出的五个公平性标准（即财富保值、采用率提升、安全性增强、治理结构完善以及流动性维持）。在这些条件的严格版本...。

papers.title: Jacobian Rank Collapse in Decision-Focused Learning
papers.abstract: Decision-focused learning (DFL) trains predictors through downstream objectives, but a different loss need not provide an independent parameter-update direction. We characterize this restriction through the predictor Jacobian, using sparse index tracking to distinguish the covariance entries read by the optimizer from the parameter directions available to learning. Rank-one Jacobians make nonzero per-example gradients collinear; a conditional spectral bound describes near-collinearity. A batch-subspace characterization and counterexamples show why these local statements imply neither common minimizers nor collinear batch updates.   Experiments examine when geometry translates into decision quality. Across 38 one-parameter equity configurations, DFL gains over MSE remain below 1.8%; a 385-parameter conditional predictor also has pointwise rank one. In validation-tuned shortest-path and knapsack experiments, full-capacity SPO+ reduces mean regret by 11.6% and 10.6%, respectively; only knapsack survives correction across eight comparisons. The capacity contrast persists on fresh datasets across batch orders and training budgets. Holding expressivity fixed, invertible coordinate scaling lowers spectral effective rank and ordinary SGD gains; compensating for the scaling restores the original trajectories. Financial forward-target controls separate forecast accuracy from decision quality; a matched neural comparison finds no aggregate DFL advantage in the tested architecture. These findings distinguish local rank restrictions, coordinate-dependent optimization and predictive accuracy. Predictor geometry helps explain available learning directions, while held-out decision quality remains the test of practical benefit.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】决策导向学习（Decision-Focused Learning, DFL）通过下游目标来训练预测模型，但不同的损失函数并不一定需要提供独立的参数更新方向。我们通过预测模型的雅可比矩阵（Jacobian）来描述这一限制，并利用稀疏索引跟踪（sparse index tracking）技术区分优化器读取的协方差项与模型可用的参数更新方向。当雅可比矩阵的秩为一时，每个样本的梯度会变得非零且共线；条件谱界限（conditional spectral bound）可用于描述这种近似共线现象。批量子空间分析（batch-subspace analysis）和反例表明，这些局部特性既不能保证存在全局最小化器，也不能说明批量更新方向一定共线。实验验证了模型几何结构对决策质量的影响：在38种单参数股票配置中，DFL相对于均方误差（MSE）的提升幅度始终低于1.8%；一个包含385个参数的条件预测模型同样具有秩为一的特性。在经过验证调优的最短路径（shortest-path）和背包问题（knapsack problem）实验中，全容量版本的SPO+算法分别将平均遗憾值降低了11.6%和10.6%；...。研究方法：实验方法、优化方法。

papers.title: Stochastic Knothe-Rosenblatt: Light-speed Calibration of Stochastic Local Volatility Models
papers.abstract: European option smiles determine the risk-neutral marginal laws of an asset, but not their intertemporal coupling, which is decisive for many applications. The Bass martingale construction selects, among all calibrated martingales, the one closest to Bachelier dynamics; it permits fast calibration at discrete maturities and recovers the Dupire local-volatility (LV) model as the maturity grid is refined.   This article develops a modular calibration overlay for existing stochastic and path-dependent volatility models. We recursively construct a martingale that matches all prescribed marginals exactly while remaining as close as possible, in an adapted Knothe-Rosenblatt sense, to the reference dynamics. As with the Bass LV model, each calibration step is amenable to an efficient Martingale Sinkhorn algorithm. We develop the theoretical foundations, numerical implementation and consider convergence to the SLV model. We also benchmark the method for Heston and Bergomi finite-factor path-dependent volatility dynamics and develop the multi-asset extension.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】欧洲期权的定价特性决定了资产的风险中性边际分布规律，但并未揭示这些分布之间的时间耦合关系，而时间耦合关系对许多实际应用至关重要。Bass鞅构造方法能够在所有经过校准的鞅中挑选出最符合Bachelier动态特性的那个；该方法允许在离散到期日情况下快速完成参数校准，并且随着到期日网格的细化，能够逐步逼近Dupire局部波动率（LV）模型。本文为现有的随机波动率模型及路径依赖型波动率模型开发了一套模块化的校准框架。我们通过递归方式构建了一个鞅，该鞅能够精确匹配所有预设的边际分布，并在适应Knothe-Rosenblatt定义的意义上尽可能接近参考动态特性。与Bass LV模型类似，每个校准步骤均可通过高效的Martingale Sinkhorn算法来实现。我们建立了相关的理论基础，完成了数值实现，并研究了该方法向SLV模型的收敛性。此外，我们还对该方法在Heston和Bergomi提出的有限因子路径依赖型波动率模型中的应用进行了验证，并进一步开发了多资产扩展模型。。研究方法：模型校准、随机过程。

papers.title: Pair rationality and top trading cycles on single-peaked and single-dipped domains
papers.abstract: In a recent study, Ekici and Yenmez (2026) characterize top trading cycles (TTC) on the unrestricted domain by strategy-proofness, individual rationality, and pair rationality, uncovering a correspondence between the axiomatic foundations of TTC and deferred acceptance, matching theory's two canonical rules. We show that their characterization fails on the single-peaked domain, but it holds on the single-dipped domain even without strategy-proofness. They also show that pair rationality can be replaced in their characterization by two weaker conditions concerning agents' first and second choices. In contrast, this replacement fails on the single-dipped domain, even when strategy-proofness is imposed.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在最近的一项研究中，Ekici和Yenmez（2026）通过策略安全性（strategy-proofness）、个体理性（individual rationality）以及群体理性（pair rationality）来描述无限制条件下的顶级交易周期（top trading cycles，TTC），并揭示了TTC的公理基础与延迟接受机制（deferred acceptance）以及匹配理论（matching theory）中的两条核心规则之间的对应关系。研究表明，这种描述方法在单峰条件下（single-peaked domain）并不成立；然而，在单凹条件下（single-dipped domain），即使不考虑策略安全性，该描述方法仍然有效。他们还指出，在他们的描述框架中，群体理性可以被两个较为宽松的条件所替代——这些条件仅涉及代理人的首次选择和第二次选择。相比之下，即使施加了策略安全性，这种替代方法在单凹条件下也同样不适用。。

papers.title: The Capacity Cost of Informational Screening
papers.abstract: An advisor knows who would benefit from using a resource but cannot assign its use. Individuals have private assessments and may ignore advice. We study how their choices can respect a fixed usage limit. In our model, whenever coordination is possible, eliciting private assessments makes some harmful use unavoidable. Policies that maximize welfare, or even minimize harm, also forgo beneficial uses that direct assignment would permit. In those environments, observing assessments instead allows advice to achieve as much beneficial use as direct assignment, without harmful use. The loss therefore reflects the incentive cost of eliciting private beliefs while leaving use voluntary.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】一位顾问知道谁能够从使用某种资源中受益，但却无法直接指定该资源的使用者。个人对自己能否从该资源中受益有独立的判断，他们可能会忽视他人的建议。我们研究了在资源使用受到固定限制的情况下，个人如何做出选择。在我们的模型中，只要存在协调的可能性，要求个人提供自己的使用意愿评估就会不可避免地导致某些有害行为的出现。那些旨在最大化社会福利或至少将危害降到最低的政策，往往会放弃通过直接分配资源所能实现的有益用途。在这种环境下，通过观察个人的评估结果，建议同样可以实现与直接分配资源相同程度的有益效果，同时避免有害行为的产生。因此，这种损失反映了在保持资源使用自愿性的前提下，获取个人真实意愿评估所带来的激励成本。。

papers.title: Inherited Wage Dispersion and Optimal Discretion in a Dual-Rigidity TANK Model
papers.abstract: How does an inherited cross-type wage gap enter Markov-perfect discretionary monetary policy when transfers are passive? In a two-agent New Keynesian model with sticky prices and type-specific own-lag wage adjustment, the gap changes implementable allocations and the second-order welfare loss. A positive lower bound establishes its value relevance; explicit rank conditions characterize when current price inflation, wage inflation, and the output gap fail to determine the implementing nominal rate. An illustrative parameterization satisfies these conditions, although the additional state explains little nominal-rate variance after conditioning on all three aggregate variables. Welfare comparisons with fixed rules are driven mainly by aggregate wage-inflation stabilization and do not isolate the value of distributional information. Unrestricted targeted transfers separate aggregate allocation from the legacy wage-gap transition. In the CES-consistent distribution block, optimal smoothing eliminates consumption dispersion, improves on immediate wage-gap elimination, and coincides under discretion and date-0 commitment.
papers.summary_zh: 【劳动经济学】当转移支付是被动进行时，继承而来的跨类型工资差距如何影响马尔可夫完美相机抉择货币政策（Markov-perfect discretionary monetary policy）的决策过程？在一个包含粘性价格和类型特定滞后工资调整机制的双主体新凯恩斯模型（two-agent New Keynesian model）中，这种工资差距会改变可实施的资源配置方式，并导致福利损失（welfare loss）。一个正的下限值表明了该工资差距在政策决策中的实际意义；明确的排名条件（rank conditions）用于界定在何种情况下当前价格通胀、工资通胀以及产出缺口无法决定应执行的名义利率（nominal rate）。虽然额外的状态变量在考虑了这三个总体变量后对名义利率的波动解释作用有限，但一个具体的参数化设置仍能满足这些条件。与固定规则（fixed rules）下的福利比较主要受到总体工资通胀稳定性的影响，并未能凸显分配信息（distributional information）的价值。不受限制的定向转移支付（unrestricted targeted transfers）能够将总体资源配置...。

papers.title: Optimal Allocation and Volume under Surface
papers.abstract: This paper develops a framework for estimation and inference on the volumes of sets that are projections of critical function sets, focusing particularly on the convex body beneath the optimal receiver operating characteristic (ROC) surface. Specifically, we propose a volume calculation method that first uses an Aumann expectation representation and then applies Minkowski mixed volumes. Using this framework, we show that the population volume under the ROC surface (VUS) is proportional to the expectation of a symmetric U-statistic kernel. We then propose a double/debiased machine learning estimator of the VUS, derive its asymptotic properties, and develop an inference procedure. Further applications of this framework include an analysis of the feasible error set across pre-defined groups and a natural generalization of the Gini coefficient for measuring inequality.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文构建了一个用于估计和推断特定集合体积的框架，这些集合是关键函数集的投影结果，重点关注最优接收者操作特征（ROC）曲线下的凸体区域。具体而言，我们提出了一种体积计算方法：该方法首先利用Aumann期望表示法，随后应用Minkowski混合体积公式。通过该框架，我们证明了ROC曲线下的总体体积（VUS）与对称U统计量核的期望值成正比。接着，我们提出了一种用于估计VUS的双重/无偏机器学习算法，推导了其渐近性质，并构建了相应的推断流程。该框架的进一步应用包括对预定义群体中可行误差集的分析，以及为衡量不平等现象而提出的Gini系数的自然推广形式。。研究方法：机器学习。
